_sources: provisions: the head's rows, applied to HouseProperty.ownershipShare by HousePropertyNode (D-155 C2; D-160 C3, the D-150 precedent); 1961 s.26 / 2025 s.24. summary: S2 s.24(1), (2) (Gazette 265620 p.48); 1961 s.26 (thc p.148). routes[0]: the share applied to the property's income. routes[1]: s.24(2), each co-owner's own-residence nil. disqualifiers[0]: s.24(1) by contrast — no AOP person type.
summary: Where you own a house with others in definite and ascertainable shares, you are not taxed together as an association; each of you is taxed on your own share of its income, and each may treat it as your own residence.

routes.name: Your share of the house
routes.description: The house's income is computed and your share of it is taxed.

routes.name: Your own residence as a co-owner
routes.description: Each co-owner is entitled to the nil value separately.

disqualifiers.description: Shares that are not definite and ascertainable are taxed together.
